label: Apparent-past equivalence, calibration bootstrapping and the warrant for scientific laws
summary:
Original 2026-11-23 summary, retained verbatim as historical evidence; the subsequent scoped formalizations and review dispositions follow. Analyst investigation of a five-minute-history rival, recorded in docs/notes/ultimate-explanation-and-knowledge-737.md#historical-traces-and-scientific-induction-under-a-fabricated-past-rival-2026-11-23. Two admissible full histories with identical present records and opposed past facts prevent a present-record-only method from achieving universal historical factivity. A second-order argument shows that a calibration record which is itself among the potentially fabricated traces cannot independently *prove* its own historical reliability against global fabrication. Neither result makes the rival likely or defeats fallibilist, coherentist, probabilistic or externally reliable confidence. Essential origin can distinguish the numerically genuine fossil from a replica without making them observably distinct. The stronger step from absence of ultimate explanation to global trace replacement, the reliability calibration of an actual method, and the epistemic benefit of an actual divine source remain OPEN. No new Lean theorem, graph edge, premise discharge, source attribution or stronger God-existence conclusion. Requires independent semantic challenge.

Historical PR-1933 initial-history assessment (2026-11-24; retained at its original scope). Targets: 608a262d-08fe-4dfd-9413-67e2ecf35b84. Scope: Exact initial-condition restrictions for positive historical record soundness under fixed deterministic laws Assessment: New certificates characterize sound positive records by true content throughout each admitted positive observation fiber, equivalently uniformity plus an authentic member per inhabited positive fiber. Uniformly false fibers fail. Complete trajectories retain time-zero distinctions but present states can converge and a deterministic truth-linked channel can correct false records. Essential origin with identified existing bearers is a sufficient route to uniform origin; essential identity alone does not establish observation-based identification or truth. Logical controls do not establish fabricated-past admissibility, equal credibility, skeptical defeat or absence of fallible knowledge. Next test at that checkpoint: Instantiate a genuine historical evidence channel with interpreted historical content and complete state/memory, then warrant its admitted-input restriction or truth-linked production. Evaluate an actual false-positive fiber under the same epistemic standard. Evidence-only calibration cannot distinguish stipulated same-evidence alternatives; independent, direct or cumulative warrant remains eligible. Substantive note: docs/notes/fixed-initial-history-535.md#initial-conditions-and-authentic-historical-evidence-2026-11-24. Recorded review/publication disposition: accepted_qualified / published at 2648404f2213921de852b8c4ff94359825a6ed4c. Review and publication evidence: Independent semantic challenge by fresh /root/semantic_challenge accepted the complete consequential outcome at 0ba63817f91c66a6dc0dae3c741c9b485845b249. Scope: nine certificate definitions/types/proofs and bindings, four notes, graph, comparative judgments, reconciled attempts and PR draft (SHA256 1083c3de697831569cbb05afa9f29cf6d0db4a8c30b843a3402fda8bc3dc01d0). Sufficient/necessary wording, a note link and graph-case wording were repaired without theorem changes. Qualified acceptance preserves open metaphysical adequacy/application bridges and does not substitute for canonical verification or establish root premises. Published in PR-1933. The same independent challenger inspected the six-file review-bookkeeping delta and the fetched remote snapshot 2648404f2213921de852b8c4ff94359825a6ed4c, verified its tree 4c5df10cefcf92a0b4e892c15c48f3f4c7ac1f4f equals local 550e882a0315260ef7f2b896ceb3588a45e1c23b, and accepted unchanged substance with no new findings. Publication is not merge or formal gate acceptance. Scoped supersession recorded at that checkpoint: Extends rather than reverses the #1904 historical assessment: the general continuity demand now has an exact positive-fiber criterion and sufficient identity bridge. Real-world admissibility and epistemic warrant remain unresolved.

Historical PR-1927 deterministic adaptive-history assessment (2026-11-24; retained at its original scope). Targets: 608a262d-08fe-4dfd-9413-67e2ecf35b84, 54fb5040-cbe9-4285-ab74-86cfaeac8628, 62d59ef4-fc23-4f8f-86f6-9af03c4ecc1e. Scope: The deterministic finite-adaptive extension of apparent-past indistinguishability, its exact-classification controls, and its conditional relevance to historical-warrant objections against exceptions to local existential PSR. No assessment of an actual probability of historical replacement or universal skeptical conclusion. Assessment: Stable output-preserving transition matching yields identical complete finite transcripts under every deterministic adaptive policy. The explicit two-bit surrogate preserves its hidden past marker under a blind but nonconstant interface; reuse of CorrectionCriterion.characterization excludes an exact transcript classifier. A supplied history-sensitive action preserves the selected equal initial readouts while breaking subsequent matching and restoring an exact classifier. These results formalize the deterministic subcase of the future-intervention argument already proposed in PR #1904 comment 7113063138 section 4; they do not establish the comment's stochastic-kernel or probability claims. The earlier present-evidence point extends to every permitted future intervention under the supplied full operational matching condition; the theorem gives a sufficient condition, not a converse. The bridge from a brute foundation to metaphysically admissible full replacement histories remains OPEN. So does loss of fallible or externalist warrant: possible counterfeits alone supply neither an adverse evidential weight nor actual unreliability. The comparison preserves the earlier moderate preference for adequate existential explanation E and suspension about universal determining explanation D; restricted primitive foundations with warranted constraints and reliable secondary processes remain surviving rivals. Classical theism has conditional additional explanatory content only if actual adequacy, productive agency and the relevant epistemic governance are warranted; necessary/person/good labels do not establish these bridges. Next test at that checkpoint: Defend a positive full-history model that specifies identities, provenance and relevant operational states while preserving the commitments actually required by the selected interpretation; qualitative replacements may differ numerically and in historical origin. Other tests are to exhibit a justified history-sensitive restriction/intervention that defeats the supplied matching premise, or to assess a rival's actual fallible or externalist entitlement without demanding exact classification. Test the proposed divine nonfrustration norm on that same evidence domain. The deterministic recursion itself is resolved; repeated present-record examples or the already established strict-norm contradiction would not address the remaining application bridges. Substantive note: docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#containment-of-evidence-and-adaptive-calibration-2026-11-24. Recorded review/publication disposition: accepted_qualified / published at 9c9cf4fc1f1786f6201c0d453789936d399ee0cc. Review and publication evidence: Independent semantic challenge of a6daf0148bc707e953610cc131ef78fcb249cff9 covered all four new result bundles, their definitions and controls, both new note sections, the complete comparative judgment and diagram, both current assessments and the PR summary. It found four P1 scope errors: strict forecasting versus explanatory parity, unnecessary preservation of historical identities/provenance, sufficient matching presented as necessary, and omitted wholly-future profile scope. These and the quantitative/common-record wording corrections were repaired. Targeted recheck 1 accepted the repaired scope at local 98818b057e9f557eec4b29112184ce8c26a23d13, whose exact tree is published as 9c9cf4fc1f1786f6201c0d453789936d399ee0cc. The recheck also accepted the primitive-list classifier proof repair, which preserves the frozen proposition and zero-axiom allowance. Both frozen Challenges are unchanged. Published in PR-1927; mechanical verification is recorded in its CI checks. Acceptance is of the qualified interpretation and synthesis, not metaphysical admissibility, premise establishment, skeptical defeat or root closure. Scoped supersession recorded at that checkpoint: For the deterministic finite-adaptive scope only, supersedes the original summary's no-new-Lean status and the earlier unverified future-intervention proposal. The original summary is retained as historical evidence. The broad metaphysical-admissibility blocker, fallible-warrant qualifications and lack of a root-premise discharge remain unchanged. The earlier requirement for independent semantic challenge is not removed until a scoped final review is recorded. No change to the E/D or same-member absence assessment of the related self-application attempt (9d7b8ae0).

Current source-to-record continuation, with its own review status recorded below. Source-to-evidence continuation at docs/notes/fixed-initial-history-535.md#source-veracity-to-observed-evidence-2026-11-24 reuses individuated Attitudes/Semantics and History/Ontic. A conditional assembly derives record truth from the same source's assertion truth at every admitted history, assertoric-plan scope, actual realization, causal record provenance and truth-preserving transmission. Exact decoded identity is strictly stronger than needed; populated controls preserve informed truthful assertion while nonassertoric signs, failed realization, corruption or another producer defeat the records. A nonmental target-copying route succeeds on the same causal and transport conditions, with a necessarily present source and actual tokens; absence of represented plans/attitudes is not a full mindlessness model. Reused ReadingSelfCertification, retaining its unrestricted constant-additive-bias scope and the supplied true-anchor burden, rather than duplicate fiber impossibility. Recipient-directed inquiry ends provide a conditional defeasible reason against systematic fabrication only with actual end/knowledge, complete policy comparison or a defended prohibition, and execution/application. Fallible corrigible inquiry does not promise every record true. Direct, primitive and cumulative anchor warrant remain eligible. New types and proofs elaborate without axioms; canonical delivered-head verification and independent challenge are coordinator-owned. No computed root premise change.
blocker: Establish which actual rival worldview warrants a past-substitution ontology, a justified probability/epistemic norm at the same evidence, or an independent causal-trace continuity principle. Compare an actual history-dependent scientific method under those fixed commitments; do not infer universally false historical knowledge merely from logical possibility or lack of a final metaphysical ground. For the source-to-record continuation: No actual historical evidence channel, independently interpreted target or warranted admitted class has been supplied. Apply the production/provenance/transport conditions to such a channel; for the source-end reply fix the recipient practice, actual epistemic undertaking, abilities and complete relevant goods, then test strict superiority of a truthful policy or an independently defended recipient-protection norm. A stable necessary impersonal copying source must be compared at the same target and epistemic standard. Do not infer fabricated-past admissibility, equal prior, or loss of fallible warrant from the abstract controls. PR-1927 resolves deterministic finite transcript agreement under the supplied sufficient matching condition; its structural history-sensitive audit does not identify an available physical channel or discharge these application burdens.

current_assessment.scope: Only the source-to-record production, provenance and transmission continuation, its historical calibration application and the recipient-directed nondeception reply. The earlier initial-history and deterministic adaptive-history assessments are preserved in the historical summary and are not reassessed here.
current_assessment.assessment: Source assertion truth alone does not guarantee all causal traces. The new conditional assembly requires intentional/assertoric coverage, actual encoding, the same producing source, and truth-preserving reception/decoding at every admitted history. Populated omission controls retain an actually asserting, sincere, accurate, complete source while each missing bridge permits false records; restored positive controls show the joint bundle is consistent. Exact content preservation is strictly stronger than truth preservation. A necessary source with no represented attitudes or plans can also produce exact target copies under the same causal and transmission conditions; this does not establish full mindlessness or an actual impersonal worldview. Existing constant-bias self-calibration results identify a same-reading certification limitation, not a general skeptical defeat; direct, primitive and cumulative anchor warrant remains eligible. A genuine recipient-directed historical epistemic end offers a conditional, defeasible reason against systematic fabrication, but ordinary corrigible inquiry does not require every record true. Neither actual channel application nor comparative worldview superiority is established.
current_assessment.next_test: Identify an actual historical evidence channel and independently interpreted target, and assess provenance, production and transport under a warranted admitted class. For the normative route hold the source abilities, recipient epistemic end, feasible alternatives and other goods fixed: test whether the truthful policy is strictly superior in the complete ordering or false inducement violates a defended recipient-protection norm. Apply the same evidential standard to a necessary impersonal truth-tracking source; retain fallible warrant without treating a self-affirming calibration report as a new discriminator.
